spec: The verification matrix behind docs/research/core-audit.md. per_game_capable is a proven static capability: true = at least one per-game save mode is established by source, shipped binary, or observation; false = absence is established; null = unknown. It does not state the active mode of a running installation — SavePlacement.granularity does that where supported. note is the concise evidence and limitation summary. save_options names the core options the audit found governing the file set and granularity; it is required for a multi-option verdict and rejected on every other one, because that verdict is exactly the claim that those options decide the answer — the resolver hands them to the caller in the 'core-multi-option' caveat so an unstated granularity says which options it depends on instead of reading as nothing-to-report. verified records, per arrangement (retrodeck / emudeck / bare), which versions the knowledge was verified against; null = never verified there. MAINTENANCE IS ENFORCED, not documented-and-hoped: strict loading requires the capability and note, a test asserts every rule card in core_oddities.json has an entry here, and the resolver attaches an 'unverified-version' caveat when a card is applied on an arrangement that is null here or whose live-read version differs from the verified one. core_library_version is the value the core's own retro_get_system_info reports (query_core), so staleness is checked against live reads on both sides.

flycast.note: [V-source/binary/live] flycast@1dac369 libretro.cpp:790-807 maps the option; oslib.cpp:38-67 builds the VMU path. Both placements observed live: shared vmu_save_*.bin under <system_directory>/dc, and 'All VMUs' writing <save_id>.<port>.bin into the redirected save directory (libretro.cpp:2142-2148), save_id being the disc's product number (emulator.cpp:838-841). 'VMU A1' is derived from the same path, not exercised. [O] arcade content: the same function names the files after the ROM instead (oslib.cpp:62), and in 'VMU A1' Naomi's B1/C1 VMUs keep the shared card — a content-platform split the card schema cannot express.
